title: Pro Per Defendant

source.release: 2026 Criminal Jury Instructions (as adopted by the Judicial Council, February 2026)

body: (The defendant[s]/______ <insert name[s] of self-represented defendant[s]>) (has/have) the right to be represented by an attorney in this trial, as do all criminal defendants in this country. (He/She/They) (has/have) decided instead to exercise (his/her/their) constitutional right to act as (his/her/their) own attorney in this case. Do not allow that decision to affect your verdict.
The court applies the rules of evidence and procedure to a (self-represented defendant/______ <insert name[s] of self-represented defendant[s]>).

bench_notes.text: This instruction may be given on request.

authority.text: • Basis for Right of Self-Representation. Sixth Amendment, Constitution of the United States; *Faretta v. California* (1975) 422 U.S. 806 [95 S.Ct. 2525, 45 L.Ed.2d 562].
